changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_connections ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, provider VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, provider_mode VARCHAR(16), provider_code VARCHAR(128), bank_name VARCHAR(255), bank_logo_url VARCHAR(512), display_name VARCHAR(255), external_customer_id VARCHAR(64), external_connection_id VARCHAR(64), external_consent_id VARCHAR(64), status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, consent_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, consent_expiring_notified_for VARCHAR(64), holder_names JSONB, last_sync_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, last_successful_sync_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, next_refresh_possible_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, last_error_code VARCHAR(64), last_error_message TEXT, last_sync_failed_notified_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_connections_provider CHECK (provider IN ('SALT_EDGE', 'STUB')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_connections_provider_mode CHECK (provider_mode IS NULL OR provider_mode IN ('PARTNER', 'CLIENT')), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_connections_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING_AUTH', 'ACTIVE', 'CONSENT_EXPIRING', 'REAUTH_REQUIRED', 'ERROR', 'DISABLED')) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_bank_connections_provider_external ON bank_connections (provider, external_connection_id) WHERE external_connection_id IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_connection_secrets ( connection_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bank_connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, ciphertext BYTEA NOT NULL, iv BYTEA NOT NULL, key_version SMALLINT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_connection_secrets_iv_len CHECK (octet_length(iv) = 12) );

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_accounts ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, type VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, connection_id BIGINT REFERENCES bank_connections (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, external_id VARCHAR(64), name VARCHAR(255), nature VARCHAR(64), holder_name VARCHAR(255), iban VARCHAR(34), account_number VARCHAR(64), currency CHAR(3) NOT NULL, balance NUMERIC(19,2), available_balance NUMERIC(19,2), opening_balance NUMERIC(19,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, default_for_cash BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, archived BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, balance_updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, included_in_ledger BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, closed_at_provider BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, has_balance_gap BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, holder_match VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN', holder_override_by VARCHAR(255), holder_override_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, holder_override_reason TEXT, transactions_cursor VARCHAR(64), created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_accounts_type CHECK (type IN ('BANK', 'CASH')), -- BANK is provider-backed (connection + external id), CASH has neither. CONSTRAINT ck_bank_accounts_type_refs CHECK ( (type = 'BANK' AND connection_id IS NOT NULL AND external_id IS NOT NULL) OR (type = 'CASH' AND connection_id IS NULL AND external_id IS NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_accounts_cash_default CHECK (NOT default_for_cash OR type = 'CASH'), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_accounts_cash_included CHECK (type <> 'CASH' OR included_in_ledger), CONSTRAINT ck_bank_accounts_holder_match CHECK (holder_match IN ('MATCH', 'MISMATCH', 'UNKNOWN')), CONSTRAINT uq_bank_accounts_connection_external UNIQUE (connection_id, external_id) ); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_accounts_iban ON bank_accounts (iban); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_bank_accounts_default_cash_currency ON bank_accounts (currency) WHERE type = 'CASH' AND default_for_cash;

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE bank_balance_gaps ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES bank_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, period_from TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, period_to TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, expected NUMERIC(19,2), actual NUMERIC(19,2), difference NUMERIC(19,2), acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, acknowledged_by VARCHAR(255), note TEXT, created_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), created_by VARCHAR(255), updated_date TIMESTAMP, updated_by VARCHAR(255) ); CREATE INDEX ix_bank_balance_gaps_account ON bank_balance_gaps (account_id);
